title: Method: inspect_plugin
description: Opens the '.keyforgeplugin' package at 'path' on the daemon host's filesystem and validates it exactly as install_plugin would (including rejecting a package with no entrypoint for the daemon host's OS), without installing or changing anything. Lets a client show a confirmation (name, author, version, actions) before installing.

path.description: Filesystem path on the daemon host of the '.keyforgeplugin' package.

installed_version.description: Version of the plugin with the same id that is currently installed, if any. Installing the package would replace it.
